snippet.title: Valheim: 1.0 Out Now
snippet.description:
Early Access is over, and Valheim has officially arrived to 1.0! Gather your friends or explore the tenth world on your own, and prove yourself worthy in the eyes of the Allfather!

Valheim is available for PC on Steam, Microsoft and Humble, for Mac on the Mac App Store, for Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S, for PlayStation 5 and for Nintendo Switch 2.

Valheim is made by developer Iron Gate, published by Coffee Stain Publishing.
